title: Lesson 3 - Field-Level Security Fundamentals: Field Permissions, Standard vs Custom Fields
description: Given a scenario, recommend the correct level of field permissions needed to provide the appropriate access to a set of users.

questions.question: A Sales user should see the Opportunity Amount but never the Discount custom field. What field permission change is required?
options: Remove Discount from the page layout only
questions.explanation: Hidden is the only FLS state that removes the field from view for that user. Read-Only still displays it, layout removal alone leaves it exposed via search/reports, and hiding Amount is the opposite of the need.

questions.question: Which statement about field-level security is TRUE?
options: A user who can read an object always sees every field
Hidden fields are still returned by user-mode Apex SOQL unless enforced
Read-only fields are invisible to the user
FLS only applies to custom fields
questions.explanation: User-mode Apex returns hidden fields unless the code applies Security Enforced or StripInaccessible; FLS is not automatic in all code paths. Reading an object does not grant field visibility, and FLS applies to standard fields too.

questions.question: Why is removing a field from a page layout alone insufficient to secure a sensitive standard field?
options: Layout changes apply to all users
The field can still appear in search, list views, and reports where FLS is not honored
Layouts do not control standard objects
questions.explanation: Page layouts only affect record pages; search, list views, and reports surface fields by FLS, so a field visible in FLS but absent from a layout is still exposed in those surfaces.
